notes.title: Released!
notes.content: The Magnet Trials is now released

notes.title: New Ruins Levels
notes.content: Two new levels in the ruins area have been added, an outdoor one where the player flys from platform to platform, and one inside a temple with traps.

notes.title: Small Delay
notes.content: Due to the final bits of development taking a bit longer than expected, we are going to have a small delay, from Feb 8, to Feb 22.

notes.title: Improvements to base
notes.content:
Made several improvements to the base in the beginning of the game:
[list]
[*] Better textures
[*] Interesting transitions between levels
[*] Improved effects, such as explosions and sparks
[/list]

Also improved the launchpad area with a more interesting landscape, better colors and changing the lighting to nighttime.
